d:
A Rajasthan IAS officer and his family purchased 40 villas and cottages from the same company over a period of around two and a half years. The properties were bought for a combined amount of around Rs 6.16 crore and were later leased back to the same company.
The 40 properties were reportedly expected to generate around Rs 1.80 crore in annual lease income. The Rajasthan Anti-Corruption Bureau is investigating allegations of misuse of official position and undue benefits to the company.
The officer and his IPS wife have also been placed on Awaiting Posting Orders as the probe continues.
